Glycyrrhizin is about fifty times sweeter than sugar and is best known as the flavor of licorice. It is a natural extract of the roots of the licorice plant. Am I saying you shouldn't eat more than a few pieces of licorice a day? No, I'm saying that glycyrrhizin in larger doses in clearly toxic, and if the safety margins typically applied to synthetic compounds were applied to it, that's what the official recommendation would be. Do with that information what you will. Because it's a natural extract that has not yet been successfully challenged, there are no legal restrictions on how much glycyrrhizin may be in a food.
